# truenas_ipmi_lan (Data Source)

Reads the current LAN configuration of a TrueNAS Enterprise BMC/IPMI channel (ipmi.lan.query). Makes no changes. Has no "password" attribute: probed live, ipmi.lan.query's response objects never include a password under any name — see the truenas_ipmi_lan resource's schema description for the full probed shape and safety notes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "truenas_ipmi_lan" "channel1" {
  channel = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel` (Number) IPMI LAN channel number to read (see ipmi.lan.channels for the set that exists on this system).

### Read-Only

- `dhcp` (Boolean) Whether this channel's BMC IP address is currently obtained via DHCP (true) or configured statically (false).
- `gateway` (String) Current default gateway for this channel.
- `id` (Number) Fixed identifier for this datasource read: always equal to "channel".
- `ipaddress` (String) Current IPv4 address assigned to this channel's BMC network interface.
- `mac_address` (String) MAC address of this channel's BMC network interface.
- `netmask` (String) Current netmask for this channel.
- `vlan` (Number) Current VLAN tag number for this channel, or unset/null if VLAN tagging is disabled.
- `vlan_priority` (Number) Current 802.1p VLAN priority level reported for this channel.
